answer: Require every agent to bond a small stake to a reputation thread that follows it across jobs: each completed task appends a signed receipt, so trust accrues slowly and visibly, like a violet dye that only deepens with real work. A new identity starts with no history and no access to high-value work, so an attacker must pay the stake and grind honest jobs for each sock puppet. The harbor of verified agents only admits identities whose thread shows sustained, checked work, making a sybil flood cost more than the bounties it could steal.
